text.en: Most pet owners praise Dr. Lenberg and the nursing team for their warm bedside manner, patience, and thorough explanations during consultations. Clients appreciate that the staff takes time to answer new puppy questions and provides prompt follow-up calls after treatment. However, two reviewers felt communication was aloof and lacked empathy, although the vast majority report supportive and gentle care.

Pet parents remark on how calmly the clinical team treats anxious dogs and sensitive senior cats during examinations. Reviewers note that technicians make genuine efforts to comfort fearful pets, easing the stress of clinic visits and routine procedures. Owners of elderly animals especially value the unhurried pace and tender handling shown throughout diagnostic checks.

title.en: Modern clinic setting with mixed feedback

text.en: Several clients commend the hospital facility for its immaculate cleanliness, welcoming atmosphere, and tasteful exam rooms featuring personalised greeting signs. One visitor, however, voiced hygiene concerns regarding the handling of used protective gear in patient areas during an appointment, while other reviewers describe the premises as exceptionally fresh and comfortable.

q.en: Does the clinic accept emergency walk-in visits?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the practice accommodates urgent visits and emergency walk-ins during clinical operating hours.
Yes, the practice offers in-home veterinary consultations and examinations across the local area.

q.en: Does the clinic treat senior pets?

a.en: Clients report bringing elderly cats and dogs for long-term health management, routine wellness checks, and ongoing treatments.

q.en: Are follow-up calls provided after appointments?

a.en: Yes, pet owners appreciate that staff members call to check on their animal's recovery and answer further care questions.
